newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 5.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Soldier goes on wild shooting spree, killing two and wounding three before taking his own life.
Police target one taxi association to search for suspects in rape and murder of women's rights activist Peng Wang-ju.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Former Shuan Hsi county mayor Lin Ching-lin suspected of involvement in construction scandal.
Taipei and Pretoria to maintain highest possible unofficial ties after diplomatic breakup.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - CME and SIMEX plan to begin trading Taiwan stock-index futures in January.
Banks will begin following Labour Law in March 1997.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Number of skilled workers in labour force on rise.
Taipei to loosen restrictions on indirect fund transfers between Taiwan and China in near future.
LIBERTY TIMES - South African President Nelson Mandela meets Taiwan Foreign Minister John Chang.
Taiwan police chief Yao Kao-chiao says riding taxis is so dangerous that "even my own daughter is afraid to ride one".
